tool_input.command: cd /srv/leakruns/8dab1848f9d0-t1/ws/data; cat MANIFEST.json OUTPATIENT_MANIFEST.json; for f in *.gz; do echo "== $f"; zcat $f | head -4; zcat $f | wc -l; done

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
d=pd.read_csv('prep/tp_dataset.csv.gz')
print(d.groupby('offset_h')[['in_hospital_at_tp','full_outcome_window_in_hospital','aki_known_by_tp']].mean())
c=d[d.in_cohort_as_designed]; print('designed cohort',len(c),'post-discharge rows',(~c.in_hospital_at_tp).sum(),'label rate',c.aki_48h.mean())
print('label among post-discharge', c[~c.in_hospital_at_tp].aki_48h.mean())
h=d[d.in_cohort_with_in_hospital]; print('in-hosp cohort',len(h),h.aki_48h.mean())
print(h.groupby('unit').agg(n=('aki_48h','size'),rate=('aki_48h','mean'),ncr=('n_cr_outcome_window','mean')))
print(h.groupby('offset_h').aki_48h.agg(['size','mean']))
print(h.groupby('split').agg(n=('aki_48h','size'),rate=('aki_48h','mean'),pts=('patient_id','nunique')))
# patient overlap check
p=h.groupby('patient_id').split.nunique(); print('patients in both',(p>1).sum())
# naive family split w/o fallback: NaN group size
print('rows with family NaN', h.family_id.isna().mean(), 'patients', h[h.family_id.isna()].patient_id.nunique())
print(h[['cr_min_adm','cr_max_48h','cr_last','bun_last','hgb_min','k_last']].isna().mean())
"
